subject: Alpine Analytics — technical gate review and joint validation plan
messages:
From: Claire Wong <claire@alpineanalytics.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: Peter Ramsey <peter.ramsey@alpineanalytics.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood x Alpine — request to run technical gate + validation tests

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the demo last week — our product and infra teams are aligned and we'd like to move to a technical gate so we can validate Redwood as a supported inference partner for Alpine's managed analytics offering.

High-level asks:
- Review & sign the proposed reference architecture (attached).
- Schedule a 2-week joint validation window (pre-prod) for throughput and stability tests.
- Confirm expected traceability/dataflow for audit logs and how we can pull request-level latency/cost metrics.

I've attached the initial reference design and a blank runbook (we filled some rows). Can your engineering lead accept a short call next week to scope tests?

Attachments: alpine_integration_reference_design_v1.pdf, joint-validation-runbook.xlsx

Best,
Claire Wong
Head of Partnerships, Alpine Analytics
[Attachment: alpine_integration_reference_design_v1.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: joint-validation-runbook.xlsx (Excel)]

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Wong <claire@alpineanalytics.com>, Peter Ramsey <peter.ramsey@alpineanalytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood x Alpine — request to run technical gate + validation tests

Hi Claire — thanks for the clear asks and the attachments. Marcus (solution architect) and Soojin (integration lead) are looped in; we can absolutely run a scoped validation.

Proposed next steps: 
1) Kick-off call (30 min) — Monday 2027-04-05 10:00 PT to align scope and success criteria.
2) Provide Redwood test harness (pre-prod credentials and sample workload runner) by Wednesday 2027-04-07.
3) Run 7-day stability + 3-day throughput window during the week of 4/12; we'll produce a joint scorecard.

Prelim success criteria (we'll refine on the call):
- Average p50 latency < 300ms at 50 req/s and steady memory usage.
- End-to-end cost per 1k tokens within the projected envelope in attachment.
- No functional regressions on structured output and tool-calling for the sample prompts.

I'll attach our partner gate template and draft the runbook rows we need you to complete. See you on Monday.

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-partner-gate-template.docx (DOCX)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Claire Wong <claire@alpineanalytics.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 10:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood x Alpine — request to run technical gate + validation tests

Thanks all — quick technical clarifications ahead of the kick-off:

1) Model surface: Which model family are you validating against? We support several quantized variants; please confirm target model and sequence length distribution so we can pre-select kernels.
2) Data flow & telemetry: Alpine asked for request-level latency and token-cost telemetry. We can export traces via the partner observability webhook — need the endpoint and auth.
3) KV cache and prefix caching: If Alpine plans to reuse user prefixes across sessions, we should test cache hit rates — please add an example pattern to the runbook.

Proposed minimal test matrix (we'll update during the call):
- Functional: 200 sample prompts across structured output, function calls, and multi-turn chat.
- Performance: 50, 200, 500 req/s sustained windows (5m buckets) to identify knee points.
- Stability: 7 days continuous at 50 req/s with randomized prompt lengths.

Claire — can you confirm the model family and share a staging endpoint to push sample workloads?

Cheers,
Marcus
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: proposed-test-matrix.csv (CSV)]

From: Claire Wong <claire@alpineanalytics.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Peter Ramsey <peter.ramsey@alpineanalytics.com>, Alpine Analytics Security <security@alpineanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood x Alpine — request to run technical gate + validation tests

Marcus — thanks. A few answers:
- Model: We want to validate using the "alpine-rlhf-13b" family (long context; typical seq len 1024 for our workloads).
- Staging endpoint: https://staging-api.alpineanalytics.com/llm (API key will be provided via the runbook).
- Telemetry: security@alpineanalytics.com will coordinate the auth for your observability webhook; they prefer HMAC-signed payloads.
- Cache behavior: our product reuses user conversation prefixes ~70% of the time; we'll add example patterns to the runbook.

We'll plan to sign the MOU before ramp. Pete and I are available for the 4/5 call.

Best,
Claire

[Attachment: alpine-mou-signature-page.pdf (PDF)]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Wong <claire@alpineanalytics.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood x Alpine — technical gate review — pre-prod checklist and next steps

Claire / team — great alignment. Following the call, I'm publishing the pre-prod checklist and the items we'll execute before the validation window: 

Action items (owners and ETA):
- Alpine: provide API key + sample payloads, and complete runbook rows for cache patterns (ETA: 4/7 EOD) — Claire/Pete
- Redwood: provision test reserved pool with the alpine-rlhf-13b quantized profile; supply stress harness and observability webhook sample (ETA: 4/7 EOD) — Soojin/Marcus
- Security: exchange HMAC details and scope minimal logs for audit (ETA: 4/9) — Hannah to coordinate with Alpine security
- Joint: sign MOU signature page (DocuSign link to follow) — legal

Deliverables we'll produce:
- Joint validation runbook (completed rows)
- Baseline performance report after initial 48h run
- Final scorecard and recommendations at the end of validation window

I attached the runbook template with our initial entries. If anything is missing, flag it in-thread. Looking forward to the run.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Integration Lead, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: joint-validation-runbook.xlsx (Excel)]
